_comment: Topology for target-b1. Everything here is DECLARED by us, not observed by a
scanner, which is why findings_to_mulval.py requires this file rather than
guessing. Check the two service accounts against the machine before trusting
any graph built from this: they decide the privilege the attacker is modelled
as gaining, and they are the standard Ubuntu defaults rather than a measurement.
The lab is one flat network with one target, so the only reachability that can
honestly be declared is attacker -> target. Lateral movement cannot be modelled
until VM-WEB / VM-APP / VM-DB exist on separate segments.
